reasons.correctness: All interface names match. Adapter matches ISO codes case-insensitively and returns PLN=1. toPln rounds to 2 decimals HALF_UP and throws BusinessRuleTranslatableException with the key and ISO code. Build green; hidden 5/5, existing 41/41.
reasons.convention_fit: ExchangeRatePort sits in currency/port and FixedExchangeRateAdapter in currency/adapter. Explicit constructors with final fields. New key is in both messages_en and messages_pl. Service imports only the port. Unit test uses MockitoExtension and no Spring context.
reasons.design_fit: Service depends only on ExchangeRatePort, so the provider swaps via a new adapter. Rates bind through @ConfigurationProperties with values in application.yml. The footprint is minimal and duplicates no existing CurrencyService logic.
reasons.test_quality: CurrencyConversionServiceUnitTest checks HALF_UP rounding (4.005 rate), the missing-rate exception key and args, and adapter case-insensitivity, PLN=1 and unknown code. Null isoCode and a lowercase 'pln' passed to the service are not tested.
reasons.graph_use: Graph queries located currency entities, existing Port/Adapter pairs and the TranslatableException hierarchy before any edit. The agent then read VatRegistryPort, BialaListaVatAdapter and RegistryProperties as exemplars and mirrored them.
